description:
Spacious 4-bedroom private home, furnished and all-inclusive for stays of 1 to 12 months, in the heart of Indiana, PA, just 3 minutes from Downtown Indiana. The house has a large front and back yard with a back porch and a barbecue grill, a private patio and an oversized driveway that fits up to 4 vehicles. Inside you'll find generous living space, four comfortable bedrooms (three queen beds and one king bed), two full bathrooms (one upstairs, one in the basement) and a full kitchen. It's perfect for families, travel professionals and groups. Whether you're visiting for work, school or a weekend getaway, this home offers privacy, convenience and comfort.

Great for: families visiting IUP, travel nurses and medical professionals, corporate housing, group stays, long-term guests and weekend visitors. Ideal if you want a full private home with yard space and easy parking.

What's yours: the entire 4-bedroom house, the large backyard, the front yard patio, the full kitchen, the laundry room in the basement, the back porch with a barbecue grill, the garage and the private driveway (room for 4 cars). There are no shared spaces; the whole home is yours.

Check-in is self check-in, for flexibility and privacy. We're always available by message if you need help, local recommendations or support during your stay.

The neighborhood: a quiet residential street in the heart of Indiana, PA. The area is peaceful and safe, and close to downtown shops, restaurants, hospitals and the IUP campus.

Getting around: 3 minutes to Downtown Indiana, 5 minutes to IRMC Hospital (Indiana Regional Medical Center) and 5 minutes to IUP. Large private driveway and easy access to main roads, perfect for guests traveling with several vehicles or larger groups.

All-inclusive monthly rent: utilities, Wi-Fi and streaming are included. Fits up to 8 people. Minimum stay 1 month, maximum 12 months.
